name: Cauã Cardoso
quote: Determination is what I value in a great doctor.
intro: I’m Cauã, a high school junior interested in biology, medicine, and service. I hope to become a physician who keeps learning and makes a difference in patients’ lives.
aboutLead: I am drawn to medicine because I enjoy solving problems, learning how things work, and being there for others.
storyTitle: A lab coat and a love of building
values: Ethical commitment. Care for people. A commitment to keep learning.
goals: Become a physician committed to patient-centered care
Keep learning through medicine and scientific research
Serve communities through health and education
Mentor students interested in science and medicine
story: As a child, I loved wearing the white lab coat my grandmother gave me, with my name embroidered over my heart. Even when the weather was hot, I wanted to keep it on during science lessons. It made me feel like I was learning to become a scientist.
I also spent hours building things with LEGO. I liked working through a problem, trying again, and finally finding a way to make an idea work.
Those interests have stayed with me. I want to study medicine because the determination to learn and solve problems matters most when it can help another person.
